title: RBI Penalty on Infinity Fincorp Solutions Private Limited for KYC and Fair Practice Code Violations
description: <cite index="15-2">The RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹5.40 lakh on Infinity Fincorp Solutions Private Limited for non-compliance with certain provisions of the RBI (Know Your Customer (KYC)) Directions and the directions issued by RBI on Fair Practice Code.</cite>
